title: every Windows cairn box runs PostgreSQL as a host service, so a bus comes up there and asks CodeMother
intention: Every Windows cairn box runs PostgreSQL as an automatic Windows service on 127.0.0.1:5432, with a LOGIN CREATEDB role for the OS user, a pgpass in db_domain's instance space (~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass), and a store.connect() that reaches the cairn database, so a bus (live or scratch) comes up on Windows and asks CodeMother instead of dying at its transit table.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akienyoga9i: scratch_bus.launch('codemother') raised 'ConnectionError: no bus process answered ... within 15s'; the spawned bus had died first, in ~/.cairn/logs/bus.log, at ensure_database: 'psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "127.0.0.1", port 5432 failed: Connection refused (10061)'. yoga has no PostgreSQL at all, so the /sorted door, which asks CodeMother over the bus since 17d570c10390, cannot cast there. Recovery carries no PostgreSQL recipe on any platform.
traces_to: Outline 11.3.5, 11.3.5.1, 6.3.5; Law 3 (verify measures before anything is called up); Law 7 (verify names the first missing piece).
how: The host-seam intention carries a six-step apply (secrets generated into files, the EDB installer by Akien's one elevated winget command, role and database created unprivileged, the options file deleted) and a verify that names the first missing piece. Prove by the verify on a Windows box and by a scratch-HOME /sorted cast there.

clauses.claim: the seam's verify command exits 0 on a Windows box after the apply (red-first: 'RED: nothing on 5432' on yoga before it)
on that Windows box, a scratch-HOME /sorted cast reaches CodeMother over the scratch bus and lands; a local-fallback cast that skips CodeMother does not count
the same cast proof stays green on Linux

decisions.text: D1: the host-seam intention, with its apply, verify, horizon and cost, berths in intentions-not-beside-code; step 2 is Akien's one elevated command and nothing else elevates.

measured.saw: the scratch bus died at ensure_database: Connection refused on 127.0.0.1:5432; nothing listening on 5432, no postgresql service, no db_domain instance dir
measured.how: akienyoga9i_cc_0 on akienyoga9i: scratch_bus.launch('codemother') and ~/.cairn/logs/bus.log, relayed by message
